name: Layout
description: Page-level layout with header, sidebar, content, and footer areas. Sub-components LayoutHeader, LayoutSidebar, LayoutContent, and LayoutFooter provide semantic structure for application shells.

notes: Layout is a structural utility. Sub-components render semantic HTML landmarks where appropriate.
Ensure skip navigation is provided for keyboard users (use SkipNav).

children.description: Layout sub-components: LayoutHeader, LayoutSidebar, LayoutContent, LayoutFooter.

subcomponents.LayoutHeader: Renders a <header> element for the top area of the page layout.
subcomponents.LayoutSidebar: Renders an <aside> element for the side navigation area.
subcomponents.LayoutContent: Renders a <main> element for the primary content area.
subcomponents.LayoutFooter: Renders a <footer> element for the bottom area of the page layout.

do: Use Layout as the outermost structural wrapper for application pages.
Use LayoutContent for the primary scrollable content region.
Use LayoutSidebar for persistent navigation or secondary content.
Pair with SkipNav so keyboard users can bypass navigation.
dont: Do not nest Layout inside another Layout.
Do not place page content outside of LayoutContent.
Do not use Layout for card or component-level layouts — use Box or Stack.
